$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — CapabilityRegistry. Major version 1. Machine-readable, source-backed inventory of what a platform instance actually offers, with proof status. The converter is a consumer of installed capabilities; it never invents a capability to fit a design. Payload VALUES may name platforms; this SCHEMA must stay platform-neutral (guarded by the repo neutrality test).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Capability Registry

platformId.description: Adapter-declared platform id, e.g. a real platform or a synthetic fixture platform. A value, never a schema literal.

profileId.description: Audit context. A registry is reusable across projects of the same platform revision.

generator.description: Provenance of the probe that produced this registry.

capabilities.description: One entry per capability x appearance. MUST be sorted by (id, appearanceId) in Unicode code-point order — deterministic ordering is normative.

summary.description: Derived counts. The semantic validator asserts they match the capabilities array (unit test; not expressible in JSON Schema).

diagnostics.description: Sorted by (code, severity rank info<warning<error, subject.id, message).

provider.description: Platform namespace as observed (value-level), e.g. an owning module/extension name carried verbatim for traceability.

category.description: Closed enum. 'unsupported' entries are recorded explicitly with unsupportedReason — never omitted (fail closed). 'chrome' marks platform/theme chrome that is out of CMS-page scope.

availability.description: Closed enum. Captures observed enablement; 'unknown' requires a NOT_VERIFIED diagnostic and blocks promotion beyond 'discovered'.

allowedChildren.description: Sorted by (policy presence, capabilityId): policy entries first (allow-all before deny-all), then concrete entries by capabilityId.

allowedParents.description: Same shape as allowedChildren. Disagreement between a parent's allowedChildren and a child's allowedParents emits NESTING_DECLARATION_CONFLICT (warning).

scope.description: Adapter-defined scope token (e.g. a viewport or breakpoint name).

responsiveRules.description: Sorted by scope. Core constrains shape only; scope/effect vocabularies are adapter-defined.

responsiveDeterministic.description: false means the resolver must emit RESPONSIVE_UNCERTAIN for any mapped use of this capability.

dataSources.description: Sorted, adapter-defined data-source ids. Business/runtime data resolves against the platform context — never against design-source demo data.

editorEditingMode.description: Closed enum. How the platform's editor edits this capability.

dependencies.description: Sorted; capability ids or adapter module ids (values).

evidence.description: What backs every field above. Rendered artifacts alone cannot justify proofLevel 'registered'.

name.description: Adapter-faithful field name or payload path (brackets allowed, e.g. items[].title).

type.description: Closed enum. 'unknown' is honest when a probe did not audit the field's type; it must be paired with a NOT_VERIFIED diagnostic at payload level.

responsive.description: true when the prop has per-breakpoint forms.

appearances.description: When present and non-empty, the child's appearanceId must be in this set.

policy.description: Real registries declare policies, not always enumerations. A child is legal iff for every ancestor rule that applies: policy allow-all and child not in except, or an explicit concrete rule matches, and no deny-all/except rule matches.
